title: A Current for the Escarpment
author: Casper Joubert
blurb: Freya Dunmore, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
